title: NVTX and Nsight verification of ready-input Flow/HiFT overlap
profiler: Nsight Systems 2026.4.1, CUDA + NVTX, cuda-graph-trace=node, explicit CUDA Profiler API capture window
kernel_attribution: GPU kernel correlationId -> CUDA runtime launch -> same-thread enclosing NVTX ranges. No attribution from coincident GPU timestamps.

fusion_table.status: Existing default compilation retained; no new fusion implemented or inferred.

diagnostic_warning_context: Nsight emits generic possible-incomplete-event warnings. All 64 expected NVTX ranges, 40 graph launches, and all kernel-to-launch mappings are present. Region kernel signatures are compared separately; no guarantee is made about unobserved events.
interpretation: Actual Flow B graph kernels overlap HiFT A kernels in the overlap capture; none intersect in the serial control. This is kernel activity intersection, not a sum of bounding range overlaps or CPU NVTX overlap.
performance_boundary: Keep prior unprofiled completion 146.59 -> 123.58 ms (15.7% reduction). Do not use profile durations or 15.12 ms overlap as the unprofiled speedup.
scope: Two fixed ready batches of four requests, same Flow/HiFT grouping. Not C32 or full serving.
